about: Nachtschicht's own per-game profiles, tested on Macs. They take precedence over umu-protonfixes. Fields: graphics (dxmt|dxvk), arguments, dllOverrides, registry, windowsVersion, winetricks, ignoreUpstream, note.

251570.name: 7 Days to Die
251570.note: Tested 2026-10-24 on M5: ~63 FPS with DXMT; with DXVK the game sees only 128 MB VRAM and drops to low textures and ~30 FPS. Steam's no-EAC launch option is picked automatically.

3907790.name: OxyRail
3907790.note: Tested 2026-10-24 on M5: ~75 FPS with DXMT vs 45-50 with DXVK on Extreme.
